CustomField.description: List total price for this quote line item.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(AND(Renewal__c, !Existing__c, !CarryoverLine__c, ISBLANK(PriorQuantity__c)),Bundled__c),0,CASE(PricingMethod__c,'Block',ProratedListPrice__c * EffectiveQuantity__c,ProratedListPrice__c * IF(OR(AND(!Existing__c, !CarryoverLine__c), ISPICKVAL(SubscriptionPricing__c, 'Percent Of Total')),Quantity__c,Quantity__c - BLANKVALUE(PriorQuantity__c, 0) + BLANKVALUE(UpgradedQuantity__c, 0))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: List total price for this quote line item.
CustomField.label: List Total
